The page publishes Roads Hotline contacts 905-372-3329, toll-free 1-800-354-7050, and after-hours toll-free 1-866-856-3251. It also links a Paperform Report a problem route. The fetched form page only exposed its title, so report fields and acknowledgement behavior were not observed. This is a general County-road concern/jurisdiction handoff; confirm the particular road and asset before selecting it. Sidewalk and curb ownership and any safety intervention are not established merely by county location. No live report, email or call was made.
